Три направления готовы: Version Wall · The Approving Hand · Stack of 400

styles.name: Version Wall
styles.idea: One KITE demo concept turns into a crisp bento wall of ad previews in every format and language. Each tile carries Toggle's orange expert-check badge, and a huge navy line reads «Один концепт. Все версии.» on white paper.
styles.direction: HERO: a bento wall of KITE previews rebuilt from the real engine demo, in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 and in RU/EN/ES. KITE is a made-up demo brand. It is always tagged «ДЕМО · KITE» top-right and never shown as a client. Every tile uses one KITE system: a white or sky disc, a bold KITE label, two text bars and a language tag. That way the wall reads as one brand at a glance. Each tile also carries the orange expert-check badge from the site's «Experts check every file» tile. White page. Tiles use the 14px adPreview radius, and neighbouring tiles alternate navy #0C2B3F / sky #B4E4FA / gray #F1F1F1, as on concepts.toggle.studio. LOGO: the supplied TOGGLE wordmark SVG paths, unaltered, in navy, top-left at x108/y100, 32px high (3% of the short side). It sits in the same spot in every scene. In s3 the supplied Toggle Concepts lockup replaces it in the same corner. GRID: 108px margins, 20px gutter, 4px rhythm. 1:1: headline top-left on two lines, wall from y440 bleeding off the right and bottom. 4:5: same headline block; the wall gains a third row and bleeds at 1350. 9:16: the headline starts below the 250px top safe zone (y300), the wall runs y560–1580 bleeding off left and right, and the bottom 340px stay clear. 16:9: type column x108–760, wall fills the right 55% bleeding off top, right and bottom; bottom 140px clear. TYPE: Inter Tight 600 at 112px on 1080 (cap ≈ 82px, 7.6% of the short side), leading 0.95, tracking −0.035em, sentence case, left-aligned. Every headline line uses this one size. Micro-labels: Inter Tight 500, 28px, caps, +0.06em, muted #5A6B78. Tile labels: 700. CTA: Inter Tight 700, caps, 28px, white on a navy pill. ACCENT: the orange #FF4F17 check badge (r22, 4px white keyline). It is the only orange on screen until the ring appears in s3, and it never goes on text. IMAGERY: none. All UI is rebuilt in HTML/CSS from the real engine demo screens with crisp 1px #DDE3E8 rules and no invented Toggle features. MOTION: calm and precise. expo.out / power4.out entrances, text sharpens from an 8px blur in 0.24s, no bounce, one move at a time. SCENES (12 s): s1 HOOK 0–3.6. One KITE 4:5 tile sits at left with a small folio tag «№1». It scrolls up a vertical feed in 0.32s steps that speed up, then slow down, while the folio ticks, until it lands on «№400». Tile 400 looks exactly like tile 1. «Креатив №400.» sharpens in at 0.5s and «Всё ещё вы.» at 1.6s on line two. Transition: the camera pulls back (scale 1→0.3, expo.out, 0.6s) and tile 400 becomes one cell of the wall. s2 PROOF 3.6–6.2 (this keyframe). The wall builds outward from that cell with 0.6s panel wipes (cubic-bezier .7,0,.2,1): formats first, then the language tags slide RU→EN→ES in place. The orange checks stamp on tile by tile, 120ms apart, scaling 0.85→1 with no overshoot. This is the expert check, shown without words. «Один концепт. Все версии.» sharpens in. Transition: every tile wipes to white except one, which morphs its 14px corners into a 999px pill and becomes the navy CTA. s3 OFFER + CTA 6.2–12. White end card: lockup top-left, «Скидка 20% на первый месяц» on two lines at headline size, and the navy pill «НАЧАТЬ ПРОБНЫЙ МЕСЯЦ →». The supplied glossy ring PNG, upright, rises 40px into the lower right (power4.out) and holds. Nothing else moves until 12s. 6 s CUT: s1 runs 0–3 with the feed 30% faster. At 3.0, tile 400 morphs straight into the CTA pill. s3 runs 3–6 with only the lockup, the ring and «Начать пробный месяц»; the offer line is dropped. Captions for the founder's VO sit on a solid white plate above the bottom safe zone.

styles.name: The Approving Hand
styles.idea: On a deep navy field, a hard circle of real footage shows a Toggle expert's hand on a tablet under a warm desk lamp, tapping the orange check on a KITE file. «Один концепт.» runs above, with «Все версии.» on a sky band tilted −2°.
styles.direction: HERO: a hard circle of real footage showing the hand of a Toggle expert, from the real team (the founder's black knit sleeve from the founder film). The hand rests on a tablet at the studio's oak desk and taps the orange approval on a KITE demo file. Deep navy #0C2B3F field around it. The circle is the only image, cropped boldly off the right and bottom edges. LOGO: the supplied TOGGLE wordmark SVG, white, top-left at 108/100, 32px high. In s3 the supplied white Toggle Concepts lockup replaces it in the same corner. GRID: 108px margins. 1:1: two-line headline top-left; circle Ø760 centred at (730,770), bleeding off the right and bottom. Four flat format tags (9:16 · 4:5 · 1:1 · 16:9) stack in a column bottom-left on the solid navy: 8px tag radius, mist #BFD3E0 outline, active tag filled sky. 4:5: circle Ø880 centred at (720,900), tags bottom-left. 9:16: headline at y300; circle Ø960 centred at (640,1080), bleeding off the right; tags in a row under the headline; bottom 340px clear. 16:9: circle Ø900 on the right half, bleeding off top and bottom; type and the tag row in the left column; bottom 140px clear. TYPE: Inter Tight 600 at 104px on 1080 (cap ≈ 76px, 7%), leading 0.95, tracking −0.035em, white on navy, left-aligned. Tags: Inter Tight 500, 28px. CTA: Inter Tight 700, caps, 28px. ACCENT: a sky #B4E4FA highlight band tilted −2° behind the second line of every scene, with navy text on it: «Всё ещё вы.», «Все версии.», «на первый месяц». Same angle and height every time; it always wipes in left→right in 0.3s. Small text always sits on the solid navy, never over the footage. IMAGERY: shot for real at Toggle, with no actors and no stock. 85mm macro at f/2.8. A practical tungsten desk lamp sits camera-left in the founder-film room; the navy shelves fall into shadow behind a light oak desk. The grade is slightly cool with soft contrast: the lamp is held at about 4300K so skin stays natural, and shadows sit in deep navy #081F2E. No HDR. The tablet screen shows the real engine demo (KITE), composited in post. In this keyframe, the vector shapes stand in for that footage. MOTION: calm, expo.out / power4.out, no bounce. Inside the circle, only the footage changes; outside it, only the active tag. SCENES (12 s): s1 HOOK 0–3.6. The circle irises open from a point (expo.out, 0.6s) onto the tablet in macro. The thumb flicks through a feed of KITE versions, motion-blurred, and stops dead on version 400, which has the same layout as the first. «Креатив №400.» sharpens in, then «Всё ещё вы.» lands on the sky band. Transition: a match cut on the hand's movement to a slightly wider shot of the same desk; the circle never moves. s2 PROOF 3.6–6.2 (this keyframe). Inside the circle, hard cuts land every 0.4s on the music: the same concept as 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, then RU→EN→ES. Only the active format tag on the left changes, in sync with each cut. On the final beat, the fingertip taps the orange check and it fills. This is the expert check, shown without words. «Один концепт. Все версии.» Transition: the circle contracts (power2.inOut, 0.5s) and stretches into a white 92px pill that becomes the CTA. s3 OFFER + CTA 6.2–12. Navy end card: lockup top-left, «Скидка 20%» in white with «на первый месяц» on the sky band, and a white pill «НАЧАТЬ ПРОБНЫЙ МЕСЯЦ →» in navy caps. The supplied glossy ring stands upright in the lower right, lit to match the lamp, and holds. 6 s CUT: s1 runs 0–3 (two flicks, then version 400), and the circle contracts straight into the CTA pill. s3 runs 3–6 with only the lockup, the ring and «Начать пробный месяц»; the offer line is dropped. Founder VO captions sit on a navy plate above the safe zone.

styles.name: Stack of 400
styles.idea: A squared block of 400 printed proofs sits on a flat sky field. Its fore-edge shows one unbroken navy stripe, and the glossy Toggle ring stands upright on top under «Скидка 20% на первый месяц» and the navy CTA pill.
styles.direction: HERO: a real paper object. 400 printed proofs, one sheet per version of the KITE demo concept: every format and language, laid out on equal sheets with trim marks. The sheets are guillotine-trimmed and squared into one block. Every version keeps the same brand system, so the printed navy band lines up through all 400 sheets and draws one unbroken stripe across the fore-edge: brand consistency you can touch. The background is a flat sky #B4E4FA seamless field. In s3 the supplied glossy ring stands upright on top of the stack (this keyframe). It is the only 3D object and the only orange on screen. LOGO: the supplied TOGGLE wordmark SVG, navy, top-left at 108/100 in s1–s2. In s3 the supplied Toggle Concepts lockup takes the same corner, with the wordmark 32px high. Never redrawn. GRID: 108px margins. 1:1: type block top-left (headline, then the CTA pill 40px below); stack in the lower half from x390, bleeding off the right and bottom; ring centred on the top face. 4:5: the fore-edge grows taller, so the stack reads thicker; type block unchanged. 9:16: type from y300; stack y1100–1580, bleeding off both sides; bottom 340px clear. 16:9: type column left; stack fills the right 55%, bleeding off the right and bottom; bottom 140px clear. TYPE: Inter Tight 600 at 100px on 1080 (cap ≈ 73px), leading 0.96, tracking −0.035em, navy on sky, left-aligned, sentence case. CTA: Inter Tight 700, caps, 28px, +0.02em, white on a navy 999px pill (clickable = pill, per the brandbook), with a thin arrow. ACCENT: the hard-edged navy stripe. It runs through the fore-edge, and the CTA pill is that same stripe pulled out as a button. Orange appears only on the ring. CRAFT/IMAGERY: real production, not CG. Digital print on 170gsm uncoated white stock, trimmed on a guillotine, shot with a 100mm macro on a motion-control rig. Soft daylight from top-left through a large diffuser, a single soft contact shadow, a slightly cool grade with soft contrast, and no HDR. The riffle is real stop-motion at 12fps on twos. The ring is the supplied PNG, composited upright and colour-matched to the daylight. In this keyframe, a vector sketch with a line pattern stands in for that set. MOTION: calm, power4.out, no bounce. Only what changes moves. SCENES (12 s): s1 HOOK 0–3.6. Top-down macro on sheet 1, a KITE 4:5 proof. A thumb riffles the block like a flip-book: the prints flicker through formats and languages, but the layout never jumps. It stops on a sheet whose folio corner reads «400» (the approved number, as digits). «Креатив №400.» sharpens in from blur, then «Всё ещё вы.». Transition: a motion-control tilt (0.6s, expo.out) from top-down to a low 3/4 view reveals the fore-edge and its unbroken navy stripe. s2 PROOF 3.6–6.2. A hand fans the upper sheets into an arc of 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 proofs in RU/EN/ES. An expert's pencil ticks each corner in one pass: the check is shown, not said. One tap squares the fan back, and the stripe falls into a straight line again. «Один концепт. Все версии.» Transition: the block settles with no bounce, and the ring lowers straight down onto the top sheet, upright (power4.out), never spun or tilted. s3 OFFER + CTA 6.2–12 (this keyframe). Lockup, «Скидка 20% на первый месяц», the navy pill «НАЧАТЬ ПРОБНЫЙ МЕСЯЦ →», and the ring on the stack. Only the CTA arrow moves, nudging 6px once at 9s; then hold. 6 s CUT: s1 runs 0–3 (riffle 1.4s, stopping on 400), then a hard cut to the s3 set with the lockup and the ring on the stack. The offer line is dropped, and the CTA pill moves up into the headline slot. Founder VO captions sit on a solid white plate above the safe zone.
